info.title: PRISM MVP API
info.description: PRD v1.0 engineering contract. API uses UTC instants, snake_case JSON, decimal strings for bigint versions. Never accept client user_id. Mutations require UUID Idempotency-Key; repeat same command returns original result, reuse with changed payload is 409. Updates require quoted version If-Match; review uses base_version. Direct review key equals body idempotency_key. Sync has distinct batch and operation keys. Unknown fields rejected. Server validates merged PATCH state, ownership and lifecycle.
